answer: Think of Signed dental visit history with dental association attestation as a toll booth: visits the association register recorded across years of checkups, so the raven of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The jetty is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The cedar is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
